---
description: Save to memory whatever from this chat is worth remembering
---

Follow the "Memory across chats" protocol in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
(if it is not already in context, read the file).

- If the user wrote text after the command, remember exactly that. If it is already
  evident from the code or git, ask what was non-obvious about it and save that.
- If there is no text, go through this whole chat using the checklist in the
  "When to save" section and save whatever passes the test. If nothing qualifies,
  say so.

Before creating a file, check whether an entry on that topic already exists — update
it instead of creating a duplicate. Update the "Index". At the end, list the files you
created or changed.
